## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible trigger and fix. Link the issue: Closes #

## Type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Refactor / chore

## Validation

List executed checks, environment and revision. Distinguish fixtures from live provider calls.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Boundaries

State remaining gates, security/data effects and any changed configuration.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data or filled env files
- [ ] Approval gate (Jev) unchanged, or the change is explained
- [ ] Mock or unfinished features are labelled DEMO / PLANNED / PENDING; no unsupported readiness claims
